repository_overview.name: Multi-Agent-Placement-System
repository_overview.description: The repository `Multi-Agent-Placement-System` is a backend application primarily written in Python. It follows an agent-based architecture where multiple specialized agents handle different tasks. The system does not expose any API endpoints but operates as a standalone application, processing user inputs such as resumes and job descriptions to generate final responses.

onboarding_guide.architecture_explanation: The backend system follows an agent-based architecture where multiple specialized agents handle different tasks. The main components of the system include `state`, `agents`, `models`, and `utils`. These components interact through a central graph defined in `main_graph.py`, which routes the execution flow based on the current state.

```mermaid
    D1 --> E1[Process Data Based on Role]

    E1 --> F1

    F1 --> G1[Final Response]
    F2 --> G2[Final Response]
    F3 --> G3[Final Response]
    G1 --> H[Output to User]

    G3 --> H
```
